news.title: Poolin was bitcoin's biggest mining pool and now it's filing for bankruptcy
news.summary: The Singapore-based company once controlled nearly a fifth of Bitcoin's global hashrate. Now it owes $173 million and is selling off what's left.

news.title: A $5 billion cluster has formed in bitcoin options. It tells a bullish story
